subject: VP/CTO intro + technical deep dive — Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Erica Zhang <erica@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, David Kim <david@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up & VP/CTO intro — next steps

Hi Erica,

Thanks again for the great discovery call earlier — appreciate you walking us through the key priorities at Acme Health. Quick recap of what I heard:

- Primary use case: orchestrating clinical-document summarization + indexing for internal search across patient records (latency-sensitive queries).
- Major constraints: PHI considerations, SSO + KMS for key management, EU data residency for some pilot sites.
- Success criteria: end-to-end POC with <200ms median latency on typical queries and measurable cost per request under the pilot budget.

Next steps we recommended on the call:
1) Technical deep dive + demo with your CTO to validate integration pattern (SSO/KMS/data flows).
2) Share a mutual action plan with milestones & success criteria.

I've attached a short architecture overview and a draft mutual action plan for your review. Can we lock in a 45-min slot next week for a VP/CTO alignment + technical deep dive? Jonas (Product Solutions) and David (Solutions Eng) will join to run the demo and cover security/ops questions.

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue May 25, 10:00–10:45am
- Wed May 26, 2:00–2:45pm
- Thu May 27, 11:00–11:45am

If none of those work, feel free to pick a time on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/30min

Attach: [redwood-high-level-arch.pdf (PDF, 280KB)], [mutual-action-plan.xlsx (XLSX, 60KB)]

Agenda suggestion: 5-10m intros; 25m demo + architecture deep dive (data flows, SSO/KMS, quantization/latency); 10m Q&A + next steps.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning with your CTO.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Thanks Erica — Michael, great to meet you.

We can absolutely provision a short-lived sandbox for the CTO deep dive; it will include a sample dataset (non-PHI) and a KMS-backed key configuration that we can demo end-to-end. No additional NDA is required for the demo materials, but we can sign an MSA/ADDendum if your legal team prefers.

Jonas and David — note the preference for Tue/Thu mornings PT. Jonas, can you run the demo topics below?

Proposed agenda (finalizable):
- Intros (5m)
- Live demo: inference runtime + end-to-end data flow (25m) — Jonas
- Security + deployment options (10m) — David (SSO/KMS, VPC/private)
- Success criteria & mutual action plan (5m)

Michael — are you available Tue May 25, 10:00am PT or Thu May 27, 11:00am PT? If yes, I'll send a calendar invite with a Google Meet link and attach the demo agenda.

Attach: [demo-agenda.md (MD, 3KB)]

Best,
Marissa
